name: Mote
author: Erin Carter
description: Silt motes caught in a slow eddy: hash-seeded specks orbit an off-center dark vortex, inner motes circling faster than outer ones so loose clumps shear into winding spiral arcs, while the dark hub drifts on a slow Lissajous path.

params.label: Mote size
params.effect: CSS-pixel size of a silt speck, from barely-there grain to plainly visible floaters.

params.label: Spin
params.effect: Rotation rate of the eddy — 0 suspends the silt almost motionless, 1.5 stirs a lively slow whirl.

params.label: Winding
params.effect: Strength of the inner-to-outer speed gradient — low keeps clumps riding together like a disc, high shears them into tightly wound spiral arcs.

params.label: Eddy size
params.effect: CSS-pixel radius of the eddy, setting how much of the frame the turning silt occupies.
